guide.aiPrompt:
You are building with the Sulaiman AlRajhi University (SRU) Design System.

Before creating or changing any component or HTML design, read this guide and inspect the Sulaiman AlRajhi University component gallery. Find the closest existing example and use it as your reference for markup, states, spacing, typography, colors, responsive behavior, and LTR or RTL direction.

Follow these rules:
- Use the published university stylesheet and its  components and utilities. The stylesheet already includes Bootstrap; never add a second Bootstrap CSS file.
- Do not add custom styling, inline styles, CSS overrides, theme or token overrides, !important rules, or replacement styles to change the appearance of the system or its components unless the user explicitly asks for that styling or override. Do not infer permission from a request to build or implement a component.
- If the requested result cannot be built with the existing system, explain the limitation and ask the user before adding custom styles or overrides.
- Keep HTML semantic, accessible, keyboard usable, responsive, and compatible with the page direction.
- Load the Bootstrap JavaScript bundle only when interactive components need it; it already includes Popper.
- When using Lucide icons, load https://unpkg.com/lucide{'@'}latest and call lucide.createIcons() after adding the icon elements to the page.
- Use the icon names shown in the gallery. Hide decorative icons from screen readers, and give icon-only buttons a clear accessible name.

Before finishing, compare the result with the gallery example you used and confirm that no unrequested styling or overrides were introduced.

copy.introductionDescription: The Sulaiman AlRajhi University (SRU) Design System combines  with university colors, typography, and direction-specific styles. Use the same components and design tokens across university websites.
copy.bootstrapIncludedDescription: The theme stylesheet already includes Bootstrap. Add only the university stylesheet to your page.
copy.directionStylesheetDescription: Choose the direction-specific stylesheet that matches the page language.
copy.optionalJavascriptDescription: Load the bundled JavaScript only when the page uses interactive Bootstrap components.
copy.gettingStartedDescription: For developers and AI coding assistants building a Sulaiman AlRajhi University website, follow the same integration steps:
copy.chooseDirectionStylesheet: Choose the stylesheet that matches the page direction and language.
copy.buildBootstrapLayouts: Build layouts with  components and utilities; the university theme provides the shared colors and typography.
copy.loadInteractiveJavascript: Load the JavaScript bundle only when using interactive components such as modals, dropdowns, or tooltips.
copy.useGalleryExamples: Use the examples in this gallery as patterns, and check keyboard access and RTL layout when relevant.
copy.aiReviewWarning: AI agents make mistakes. You are responsible for comparing their output with the referenced gallery example and confirming it follows the design system before accepting it.
copy.installationDescription: Add the hosted stylesheet in the page head. Use the RTL file for Arabic pages and add the JavaScript bundle when interactive components need it.
copy.rtlStylesheetNote: For Arabic or another right-to-left page, use {file}. The stylesheet already includes , so do not load a second Bootstrap CSS file.
copy.heroDescription: Browse the components, states, and interactions developers can use in university websites. Switch direction and theme to preview the same system in RTL and dark mode.
copy.systemUsage: CSS includes Bootstrap and Sulaiman AlRajhi University design tokens. Add the JavaScript bundle for interactive components.
copy.foundationDescription: Bootstrap contextual colors use the university palette. Cairo is the shared font for Latin and Arabic content.
